platform_findings.name: LegalEntityRoles
platform_findings.finding: Stores roles — investor, vendor, client — on the organisation. The principles say roles come from relationships; this model derives supplier and outside manufacturer instead of storing them.

platform_findings.name: PeopleRoles
platform_findings.finding: Stores roles on the person, and uses the plural People where its siblings use Person.

platform_findings.name: LegalEntityRelationships
platform_findings.finding: Holds relationships as a concept. Relationships are now their own kind of record; not reused here.

platform_findings.name: Events domain
platform_findings.finding: Holds no concepts. Its definition describes corporate and life events only.

platform_findings.name: Transactions domain
platform_findings.finding: Holds no concepts. Its definition is written for trades in securities.

platform_findings.name: Document
platform_findings.finding: Its description calls it DocumentBase, which disagrees with its name.

platform_findings.name: PersonCitizenship
platform_findings.finding: Singular name where its siblings are plural.

platform_findings.name: LegalEntityFundManagedBy
platform_findings.finding: Inverse verb Invests In does not read back Managed By; the stored view name LegalEntityGP disagrees with its roles.

platform_findings.name: LegalEntityPEInvestor
platform_findings.finding: Forward verb Investor is a noun, not a verb.
